english: 47. “O Lord, be victorious; the entire army of Devas has been illuminated by your arms that have became red by means of the lustre of the rays of your matchless Śakti. O Lord Kumāra who causes bloom in the face of the Destroyer of the Puras like the moon amongst the cluster of lilies, be victorious. You are like the submarine fire to the ocean of the race of Daityas, O Lord having the peacock with sweet voice for your vehicle. With the sprout-like nail of the feet you have pounded the crowns of Asuras; O Mahāsena, you are like the forest-fire unto the dry grass (in the form) of the family of Tāraka; O Lord of Yogins, O Skanda, be victorious. Your lotus-like feet have been rendered brilliant by the rows of nails resembling the sun that dispels the, darkness of the worrying thoughts spreading in the sky of the heart of Yogins, O seven-day old boy-god, the burner of the grief of all the worlds.
